names: Mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids (glyceryl monostearate, glyceryl distearate)
display_name: E471 (Mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids)

more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids is used as an emulsifier in food. Its technological role is to help oil and water remain mixed.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include milk-based drinks and similar products intended for young children, unflavoured pasteurised cream (excluding reduced fat creams), unflavoured live fermented cream products and substitute products, both with a fat  content of less than 20 %, fats and oils essentially free from water  (excluding anhydrous milk fat). These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: A mixture of glycerol esters of fatty acids found in food fats and oils. The specification allows small amounts of free glycerol and fatty acids.
more_info.dietary_restrictions: The fatty-acid feedstock is not specified as exclusively plant derived. Vegan, vegetarian, halal and kosher suitability cannot be established without the supplier identifying the raw material and processing.
